Name: Ron's Hats Redone
Author: UnevenLines
Description:
Ron's Hats Redone breathes new life into the selection of hats in Stardew Valley!

Ever wanted a bit more versatility with the in-game hats, ever wanted more on-theme hats for the achievements you work tirelessly to complete? Or maybe you just want to be a giant eyeball? Now you can have it all! With new and old hats redone in the signature DrawDontStop style, and a handful of them inspired by our favourite hat mods over the years, you'll wish you had two heads! For more hats!!
                                               
                                 Just drop into your mods folder and enjoy!

     -DDS
Ps. If you're a fan of my NPC's, I'm currently updating and merging the two files! So you can get all the Sirens, in one great package!

Downloads.Description: Long awaited edits to the pet hats, now your horse should be able to wear an eyeball right along side you.
